zh.title: 中華航空調漲國際線訂位服務費 22日起升至33美元
zh.summary: 中華航空宣布9月22日起調漲國際訂位費至33美元，多家國籍航空亦陸續跟進。
body: 中華航空股份有限公司於2026年9月10日公告，參考業界標準與市場機制，將自9月22日起調整國際線機票訂位服務費。該項費用將由原本的30美元（約新台幣944元）調升至33美元（約新台幣1039元）。該訂位服務費是透過全球分銷系統（GDS）提供服務，並基於使用者付費原則隨機票代收。
除了中華航空外，其他台灣國籍航空公司也陸續調整相關費用。長榮航空與立榮航空已自8月起，針對行程起始地由菲律賓、香港以外地區出發的國際線，每張機票收取33美元。台灣虎航也自9月1日起調整費用，非旺季航班每航段調至新台幣350元，旺季航班則調至450元。此外，星宇航空也宣布自10月7日起將該費用調升至33美元。

en.title: China Airlines to Raise International Ticket Reservation Fee to $33 on Sept 22
en.summary: China Airlines will increase its international ticket reservation service fee to 33 dollars from September 22.
body: Taiwan's China Airlines announced on September 10, 2026, that it will increase its international reservation service fee starting September 22. The fee, which is processed via Global Distribution Systems (GDS) under a user-pays principle, will rise from 30 US dollars to 33 US dollars per ticket.

Other local carriers have also adjusted their reservation fees. EVA Air and UNI Air began charging 33 US dollars in August for international itineraries originating outside of the Philippines and Hong Kong. Tigerair Taiwan increased its per-segment fees on September 1, while STARLUX Airlines plans to raise its fee to 33 US dollars starting October 7.

zh.title: 聯合航空取消原定波音777客機九一一悼念飛行計畫
zh.summary: 聯合航空取消波音777客機悼念飛行；原計畫配合UA175班機撞擊時間
body: 根據外媒 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯合航空（United Airlines）已經決定取消原定使用波音 777（Boeing 777）廣體客機進行的九一一事件紀念低空飛行（flyover）計畫。
這項由航空公司籌畫的紀念飛行活動，原本預計在特定時刻飛越，時間安排特別配合了當年九一一恐怖攻擊事件中，聯合航空 UA175 號班機撞擊的精確時間點。
然而，根據相關消息，聯合航空這項原先規劃的九一一紀念飛行計畫最終未能順利推行並告吹，該公司已確定取消整個紀念飛行的執行計畫。

en.title: United Airlines Cancels Planned Boeing 777 Flyover Commemorating 9/11
en.summary: United Airlines cancels planned Boeing 777 flyover; event was timed for UA175 impact
body: United Airlines has canceled a planned commemorative flyover involving a Boeing 777 aircraft that was originally scheduled to mark the anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks. According to a report by Simple Flying, the airline's planned aerial tribute will no longer take place as previously arranged.

The commemorative flyover had been planned to occur at a specific moment, timed to coincide with the exact impact time of United Airlines Flight 175 (UA175) during the 2001 attacks. However, the carrier's arrangements for the commemorative flight fell through, leading to the cancellation of the planned event.

zh.title: 傳美軍A-10及F-15戰機於約旦基地遭伊朗飛彈襲擊受損
zh.summary: 美軍駐約旦基地遭伊朗飛彈襲擊；傳一架A-10與數架F-15戰機受損
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，在 2026 年 9 月 8 日至 9 日夜間，伊朗發動彈道飛彈襲擊，傳出導致美軍駐約旦穆瓦法克薩爾蒂空軍基地多架飛機受損。據透露，一架 A-10 雷霆二式攻擊機因被擊中失去單側機翼而嚴重受損，另有約八架 F-15E 戰機受到輕微損傷但仍能執行任務。
約旦武裝部隊發言人表示，其防空系統攔截了 20 枚彈道飛彈中的 18 枚，未造成人員傷亡，且聲明未提及飛機受損。然而，伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊宣稱襲擊目標為該基地內 F-35、F-16 與 F-15 戰機的維護及部署區域。目前雙方均未發布影像以證實其說法。

en.title: Iranian Missile Strike Reportedly Damages US A-10 and F-15E Jets in Jordan
en.summary: US Air Force A-10 and F-15E aircraft were reportedly damaged in an Iranian missile strike in Jordan.
body: According to a report by AeroTime, multiple US Air Force aircraft were reportedly damaged during an Iranian ballistic missile attack on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan overnight on September 8 and 9, 2026. Sources indicated that one A-10 Thunderbolt II attack aircraft was severely damaged and lost a wing, while approximately eight F-15E Strike Eagles sustained light damage but remained serviceable.

A spokesperson for the Jordan Armed Forces stated that its air defenses engaged twenty ballistic missiles, destroying eighteen of them, and reported no casualties, without mentioning any airbase damage. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed its strikes targeted maintenance and deployment sites for F-35, F-16, and F-15 aircraft at the base. Neither government has released imagery confirming these claims.

zh.title: 行政院審議無人機條例預計11日定調是否副署
zh.summary: 行政院審議無人機條例進入最後階段；預計9月11日對外說明是否副署
body: 行政院發言人李慧芝於2026年9月10日表示，針對立法院日前送交行政院的「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」，政院正進行條例法條與執行面審議的最後階段討論，預計將於9月11日定調是否副署，並依據討論結果對外說明。
立法院此前未審議通過行政院先前提出的「國防自主無人載具採購特別條例」草案，而是通過在野黨團版本的「強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例」，行政院是否進行副署引發各界關注。
此外，行政院已於2026年9月3日通過115年度中央政府總預算案追加預算案，其中國防預算部分共占新台幣1457億元，編列項目涵括濱海監偵型無人機等3項內容。

en.title: Taiwan Executive Yuan to Decide on Drone Act Countersignature by Sept 11
en.summary: Taiwan Cabinet is reviewing the passed drone act and expects to announce its decision by Sept 11.
body: Executive Yuan spokesperson Li Hui-zhi stated on September 10, 2026, that Taiwan's Cabinet is in the final stage of reviewing the passed Act for Strengthening Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development. The Cabinet is expected to finalize its decision on whether to countersign the act by September 11 and announce the outcome accordingly.

The Legislative Yuan did not pass the Cabinet's proposed draft act for defense drone procurement, but instead passed the opposition's version of the unmanned vehicle industry development act, making the Cabinet's decision on countersigning a key focus.

In addition, the Cabinet approved a supplementary budget proposal for fiscal year 2026 on September 3, 2026, allocating TWD 145.7 billion for national defense, which includes items such as coastal surveillance drones.

zh.title: Simple Flying一週追蹤五架發送7700代碼航班
zh.summary: Simple Flying一週追蹤五架緊急航班；事件含客艙失壓
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 的報導，該平台在一個星期之內，透過其 Simple Flying Flight Tracker 追蹤到了五架宣告緊急狀況並發送「squawk 7700」代碼的航班。這五個不同的航班在該週之內，皆經由其飛行追蹤工具進行了記錄與監測。
在該星期內被 Simple Flying 追蹤到的緊急狀況，其具體情況各有不同。報導指出，這些被記錄的事件範圍相當廣泛，其中包含了客艙失壓，也包含了廚房冒出蒸汽等不同性質的異常狀況。該摘要並未提供關於這五個航班之航空公司、機型或具體航線的進一步詳細資訊。

en.title: Simple Flying Tracks Five Squawk 7700 Emergency Flights In One Week
en.summary: Simple Flying tracked five squawk 7700 flights declaring emergencies within a one week period
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, the platform tracked five flights that used the "squawk 7700" emergency code within a single week. These five flights were monitored directly using the Simple Flying Flight Tracker. The tracking activity documented multiple emergency situations occurring within this short timeframe.

The emergencies monitored by Simple Flying on its flight tracker ranged from cabin depressurization to steam in an aircraft galley. These tracked cases represented various types of emergency events that occurred over the week. No additional details regarding the airlines, aircraft types, or routes of the five flights were provided in the summary.

zh.title: 川普前卡達專機突發逃生滑梯釋放事件；班機飛往達拉斯短暫受阻
zh.summary: 川普前卡達專機起飛前突發緊急逃生梯釋放；飛往達拉斯航班短暫延誤
body: 據 Simple Flying 報導，前身由卡達贈予、供川普搭乘的專機「空軍一號」，在預定起飛與乘客登機前夕突發充氣式緊急逃生滑梯意外部署事件。該起狀況發生於專機進行起飛前準備作業期間，導致預定飛往達拉斯的航班行程受到短暫延誤。
報導指出，機上的充氣逃生滑梯在川普登機前數分鐘突然釋放展開。事發當時該架專機正停靠於地面並準備執行飛行任務，逃生梯突發性部署隨即影響了原定時程。
此起逃生滑梯部署事件發生後，該班專機的起飛作業遭到短暫耽擱。在相關處置完成後，飛往達拉斯的行程隨後恢復進行。

en.title: Inflatable Slide Deploys on Trump's Ex-Qatari Aircraft Before Flight to Dallas
en.summary: Emergency slide deploys on Trump's ex-Qatari aircraft before takeoff; flight to Dallas briefly delayed.
body: According to Simple Flying, an inflatable emergency slide deployed on the ex-Qatari Air Force One aircraft used by Trump shortly before takeoff. The unexpected deployment occurred moments before boarding, leading to a brief delay for the scheduled flight to Dallas.

The incident involved the aircraft's inflatable escape slide deploying unexpectedly during pre-flight preparations on the ground. Trump had not yet boarded the aircraft when the slide deployed moments before his planned entry.
The sudden deployment interrupted departure procedures and briefly delayed the flight's departure to Dallas while the situation was addressed before operations could proceed.

zh.title: 荷蘭皇家空軍首架PC-7 MKX教練機在瑞士完成首飛
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家空軍首架PC-7 MKX教練機於瑞士完成首飛；預計2027年5月投入服役。
body: 荷蘭皇家空軍訂購的首架皮拉圖斯（Pilatus）PC-7 MKX 初級教練機，於2026年9月7日在瑞士施坦斯皮拉圖斯總部旁的布克斯機場（Buochs Airfield）順利完成首飛。根據荷蘭國防部公佈的資訊，此項試飛成功標誌著荷蘭軍用飛行訓練艦隊更新計畫邁入全新階段。
荷蘭國防部共計訂購了8架 PC-7 MKX 教練機與4套模擬器系統。該機型生產作業已於2026年2月正式展開，首批3架飛機將率先用於相關測試以及教官與技術人員的培訓。預計首架教練機將於2027年5月正式投入服役，包括訓練設備在內的完整包裹交付工作，計畫於2027年9月前全數完成。
新引進的 PC-7 MKX 將用於荷蘭軍方的基礎飛行課程，取代現有已接近使用壽命終點的舊型教練機。這款教練機配備馬丁貝克彈射座椅，以及專為軍用訓練定制的 Garmin G3000 Prime 數位化機艙儀表，最高操作速度達 300 節，最大爬升率為每分鐘 2,675 呎，能協助學員奠定基礎飛行技能。
除了荷蘭之外，歐洲其他國家亦逐步擴大採用 PC-7 MKX 平台。法國已選擇採購 22 架同型教練機，預計於 2027 年開始交付，並結合 Mentors 2 計畫簽署為期 17 年的服務合約；比利時則於 2025 年 11 月批准採購 18 架 PC-7 MKX 的 20 年訓練服務協議，同樣預計自 2027 年起接收飛機並於 2028 年啟動訓練。

en.title: First Dutch Pilatus PC-7 MKX military trainer completes maiden flight in Switzerland
en.summary: The Royal Netherlands Air Force first Pilatus PC-7 MKX trainer completed its maiden flight in Switzerland.
body: The first Pilatus PC-7 MKX trainer aircraft produced for the Royal Netherlands Air Force successfully completed its maiden flight on September 7, 2026. The flight took place at Buochs Airfield, located next to Pilatus headquarters in Stans, Switzerland, according to the Dutch Ministry of Defense.

The Netherlands has placed an order for eight PC-7 MKX aircraft and four full flight simulators to replace its aging basic training fleet. Production officially commenced in February 2026, with the first three aircraft assigned to support flight testing as well as instructor and technician training. The Royal Netherlands Air Force expects the first aircraft to enter operational service in May 2027, with full delivery of the complete training system scheduled for completion by September 2027.

Designed for basic military flight courses, the PC-7 MKX prepares trainee pilots before they transition to advanced military aircraft. The aircraft features Martin-Baker ejection seats and custom-adapted Garmin G3000 Prime integrated glass cockpits with tailorable displays. Performance specifications provided by Pilatus include a maximum operating speed of 300 knots indicated airspeed, a maximum climb rate of 2,675 feet per minute, and maneuverability limits ranging from +7 to -3.5 Gs.

The Dutch delivery contributes to a broader European adoption of the PC-7 MKX trainer platform. France previously selected a package of 22 aircraft scheduled for delivery starting in 2027 under a 17-year training agreement involving Babcock France. Additionally, Belgium approved a 20-year training services agreement in November 2025 covering 18 PC-7 MKX aircraft, with aircraft deliveries slated for 2027 and pilot training scheduled to commence in 2028 at Beauvechain Air Base.

zh.title: 美調查指邁阿密衝出跑道波音貨機曾試圖重飛
zh.summary: 美NTSB公布邁阿密波音767貨機事故飛行資料；調查指飛官曾試圖重飛
body: 2026年9月6日，一架由21 Air替亞馬遜航空代運營、機齡32年的波音767-300貨機（航班號為21 Air 7598號班機），在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）降落時衝出30號跑道。該架波音767-33A(ER)貨機突破機場周邊圍欄，並在公共道路上撞擊了兩輛車輛，導致地面5人不幸喪生。
美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）於9月8日召開記者會，說明初步調查進展。資深航空事故調查官 Chihoon Shin 分享了飛行紀錄器（FDR）收集到的關鍵資料。資料顯示，在紀錄結束前30秒，該機的前起落架與右主起落架以158節的地速著陸。紀錄結束前23秒，飛官開始施加煞車；隨後於紀錄結束前19秒，左主起落架以134節的地速著陸。
調查官指出，在紀錄結束前15秒，飛官於地速120節時釋放了煞車，此時油門增加至與重飛推力一致的數值，顯示駕駛可能試圖中止降落並實施重飛。然而，在紀錄結束前11秒，油門被減少至怠速功率，煞車隨後被重新啟用，當時地速為117節。直到紀錄結束，油門均保持在怠速狀態且煞車持續作動，最後一幀紀錄的地速為65節。
此外，飛行紀錄資料中並未顯示有開啟速度煞車或反推力裝置的跡象。NTSB主席 Jennifer Homendy 證實，已尋獲包含超過2小時高品質音訊的駕駛艙通話紀錄器，以及包含約55小時資料的飛行紀錄器，並送往華盛頓特區的實驗室。調查小組預計於9月9日對正副駕駛及總機師進行訪談，以釐清事故原因。

en.title: NTSB Analysis Suggests Miami 767 Cargo Pilot Attempted to Abort Landing Before Crash
en.summary: NTSB reports 21 Air Miami runway overrun; flight data indicates pilots attempted landing abort
body: On September 6, 2026, a 32-year-old Boeing 767-300 freighter, operated by 21 Air on behalf of Amazon Air as Flight 7598, overran runway 30 during its landing at Miami International Airport (MIA). The aircraft breached the airport perimeter and struck two vehicles on a public road, resulting in five ground fatalities.

National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) Senior Aviation Accident Investigator Chihoon Shin shared details from the flight data recorder (FDR), indicating that the pilot may have attempted to abort the landing. According to the recorded data, the nose gear and right main landing gear touched down 30 seconds before the end of the recording, with brakes applied 23 seconds before the end. The left main landing gear touched down 19 seconds before the end of the recording at a ground speed of 134 knots.

The data showed that brakes were released 15 seconds before the end of the recording at a speed of 120 knots, and throttles were increased to values consistent with go-around thrust. However, 11 seconds before the end, the throttles were reduced to idle power and brakes were reapplied at a speed of 117 knots. The throttles remained at idle and brakes continued to be applied until the end of the recording, which captured a final ground speed of 65 knots.

NTSB Chair Jennifer Homendy confirmed that the cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder had been taken to the NTSB laboratory in Washington DC. Shin added that there was no indication in the flight data that speed brakes or thrust reversers were deployed. The NTSB scheduled interviews with the chief pilot and two pilots onboard the incident aircraft for September 9, 2026.

zh.title: Starfighters Space與Vaya簽署協議　以F-104進行高超音速測試
zh.summary: Starfighters Space合作Vaya；以F-104進行高超音速測試
body: Starfighters Space於2026年9月9日宣布與Vaya Defense & Space達成協議，將評估利用其改裝的F-104空中測試平台，執行Vaya的高超音速測試物件與載荷飛行任務。該公司開發的機翼下模組化測試載台，能以高達2.2馬赫的速度攜帶實體尺寸組件，為航太與國防開發商提供地面風洞以外的替代方案。
Starfighters Space執行長Tim Franta指出，地面超音速風洞等待時間長達12至18個月，而這項被稱為空中風洞的載台可於單次飛行中提供超過5分鐘的真實氣流測試時間。該機翼載台可承受約1,100磅的裝備，並曾於2025年8月為GE Aerospace完成三次超音速繫留飛行測試。

en.title: Starfighters Space Partners with Vaya for F-104 Hypersonic Flight Testing
en.summary: Starfighters Space announced an agreement with Vaya Defense & Space to conduct F-104 airborne hypersonic testing.
body: Starfighters Space announced an agreement with Vaya Defense & Space on September 9, 2026, to evaluate flying hypersonic test articles and payloads aboard its F-104 aerial test platform. The company developed a modular underwing system carried on F-104 wing pylons, capable of testing hardware at speeds up to Mach 2.2 as an alternative to heavily booked ground facilities.

Starfighters Space Chief Executive Officer Tim Franta stated that ground supersonic wind tunnels currently face wait times of 12 to 18 months. In contrast, the modified F-104 offers over five minutes of exposure to real-world airflow per flight. The underwing platform can carry up to 1,100 pounds of equipment and previously completed three supersonic captive-carry flights for GE Aerospace in August 2025.
